_why: gcd on gf180mcu failed setup at 10 ns under every SYNTH_STRATEGY (WNS -1.17 ns at DELAY 2, gcd__2026-08-30__045044); the sweep was over the wrong axis. This starts from the best strategy at the period the 2026-08-30 run measured it needing (10 + 1.17 = 11.2 ns, +5%), and leaves propose_repairs() two iterations to relax further from what each run measures. It is also the first gf180mcu run that gets a KLayout DRC count (gf180_drc.py) instead of a permanent 'never checked'.
